subject.title: feat: add i18n support with zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) locale

question: Should ClawHub sponsor and maintain an application-wide i18n program beginning with English and zh-CN, or keep the web UI English-only until there is ownership for ongoing translation maintenance?
rationale: The proposal adds a cross-application capability and ongoing content-maintenance obligation; source inspection confirms no existing localization contract to extend, and prior implementation attempts were closed unmerged.

options.title: Park pending ownership
options.body: Keep this issue open as the record of demand, but defer implementation until a maintainer sponsors translation ownership and a durable i18n design.

options.title: Sponsor a phased rollout
options.body: Approve a maintained i18n program and request a narrowly scoped infrastructure-and-header PR that defines locale ownership, metadata behavior, fallback semantics, and regression coverage.

options.title: Limit localization to selected public content
options.body: Prefer curated translated documentation or landing content rather than translating the evolving signed-in product UI.

recommendation.title: Park pending ownership
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the record of demand, but defer implementation until a maintainer sponsors translation ownership and a durable i18n design.

likelyOwner.reason: They previously directed the tracking relationship for the first implementation attempt and are the strongest available evidence-backed owner for the scope decision.
